message: You know that friend who jumps to the worst-case scenario at the slightest hint of trouble? I used to be a bit like that! But I've found that having a few simple preparedness supplies can really take the edge off those anxious moments. The Red Cross has a helpful guide that walks you through what you might want to keep on hand. It’s like having a little peace of mind tucked away, just in case. 🌼 What’s one thing you always keep in your home for those unexpected days?
